faqs.question: Is Active LED Wall Installation different from Active LED Wall Solutions?
faqs.answer: Yes. Active LED Wall Solutions covers product and solution planning, while Active LED Wall Installation focuses on site readiness, mounting, cabling, controller setup, calibration, commissioning and handover.

faqs.question: Can GPSPL install LED walls supplied by GPSPL?
faqs.answer: Yes. GPSPL can supply LED display technology and also provide installation, commissioning, AMC and support.

faqs.question: What should be ready before LED wall installation?
faqs.answer: Site measurements, power readiness, wall or structure details, cable routes, access clearance, content sources and controller location should be reviewed before installation.

faqs.question: Does GPSPL handle calibration?
faqs.answer: Yes. GPSPL supports screen mapping, brightness checks, visual consistency checks, source testing and commissioning.

faqs.question: Can installation include controller and source switching?
faqs.answer: Yes. GPSPL can coordinate controller setup, source routing, AV switching and control workflow depending on the project scope.

faqs.question: Does GPSPL provide training after installation?
faqs.answer: Yes. GPSPL can provide operator guidance, handover documentation and basic troubleshooting orientation.

faqs.question: Is AMC available for installed LED walls?
faqs.answer: Yes. GPSPL can provide preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, warranty coordination and post-installation support.
